Crime & Law · India

Multiple murder and suicide incidents reported across India

Several incidents of murder and suicide have been reported from different parts of India. In Karnataka, a 21-year-old nurse was allegedly murdered by a stalker who later attempted suicide. In Maharashtra, a man reportedly killed his ex-girlfriend before dying by suicide. Other incidents include a murder in Hyderabad and a death by suicide following mental health struggles in Telangana.
